name: Maximize Hazard Risk Coverage
description: Rewards strategy portfolios that provide direct and co-benefit hazard risk reduction across flood, drought, and heatwave hazards.

name: Maximize Adaptation Priority Alignment
description: Aligns strategy selection with Phase H priority horizons (IMMEDIATE, SHORT_TERM).

name: Maximize Scientific Evidence Quality
description: Favors strategies backed by Tier 1/2 state and national evidence sources.

name: Maximize Inter-Strategy Complementarity
description: Rewards complementary and synergistic strategy pairings (e.g. drain desilting + network expansion).
